# cozystack_vmdisk (Resource)

A Cozystack VM disk, deployed inside a tenant namespace. The interactive upload source is not managed.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "cozystack_vmdisk" "ubuntu" {
  name      = "ubuntu"
  namespace = "tenant-root"
  storage   = "20Gi"

  source = {
    http = { url = "https://example.com/images/ubuntu-22.04.img" }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) VMDisk instance name (`metadata.name`). Immutable.
- `namespace` (String) Tenant namespace the application is created in. Immutable.
- `source` (Attributes) Source image used to create the disk. Set exactly one of `disk`, `http`, or `image`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--source))

### Optional

- `optical` (Boolean) Whether the disk should be considered optical.
- `storage` (String) Disk size allocated for the virtual machine (quantity, e.g. `5Gi`).
- `storage_class` (String) StorageClass used to store the data.
- `wait_for_ready` (Boolean) Block on create/update until the tenant's `Ready` condition is true.
- `wait_timeout` (String) Maximum time to wait when `wait_for_ready` is set (Go duration, e.g. `10m`).

### Read-Only

- `chart_version` (String) Deployed chart version (`status.version`).
- `id` (String) Synthetic identifier in the form `namespace/name`.
- `ready` (Boolean) Whether the application's `Ready` condition is true.
- `uid` (String) Server-assigned object UID (`metadata.uid`). Stable across updates; changes on recreate.

<a id="nestedatt--source"></a>
### Nested Schema for `source`

Optional:

- `disk` (Attributes) Clone an existing vm-disk. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--source--disk))
- `http` (Attributes) Download an image from an HTTP source. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--source--http))
- `image` (Attributes) Use an image by name from the default collection. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--source--image))

<a id="nestedatt--source--disk"></a>
### Nested Schema for `source.disk`

Required:

- `name` (String) Name of the vm-disk to clone.


<a id="nestedatt--source--http"></a>
### Nested Schema for `source.http`

Required:

- `url` (String) URL to download the image.


<a id="nestedatt--source--image"></a>
### Nested Schema for `source.image`

Required:

- `name` (String) Name of the image to use.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# VMDisk instances are imported as "<namespace>/<name>".
terraform import cozystack_vmdisk.ubuntu tenant-root/ubuntu
```
